tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: The city’s annual summer festival will take place next Saturday and Sunday. There will be activities that are fun for the whole family. You can try a variety of food, hear different kinds of music, and enjoy games for all ages. Tickets cost fifteen dollars at the gate. However, if you buy your ticket in advance, you will get a ten percent discount. Tickets are available at many local stores, as well as at City Hall. Don’t miss this fun event!
texts: The city’s annual summer festival will take place next Saturday and Sunday. There will be activities that are fun for the whole family. You can try a variety of food, hear different kinds of music, and enjoy games for all ages. Tickets cost fifteen dollars at the gate. However, if you buy your ticket in advance, you will get a ten percent discount. Tickets are available at many local stores, as well as at City Hall. Don’t miss this fun event!

Could we have your attention, please ? We’d like to take this time to thank you for attending this athletic banquet. This has been a fantastic year for our team and our athletes. We now hold a new record for most wins in our states division. Your support has allowed us to purchase new uniforms and a new scoreboard for our field. To show our appreciation for the coaches, the staff, and our fans, we'd like to invite you to view the new scoreboard, enjoy some refreshments, and meet the team. Let's give a round of applause for the three candidates for player of the year.

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Một văn phòng hiện đại với 2 đồng nghiệp đang trao đổi công việc trước màn hình máy tính xách tay.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: This is a photo taken inside a contemporary office. In the center, two colleagues are sitting side by side at a wooden conference desk. The man on the left, wearing a light blue dress shirt, is pointing directly at a data chart on the laptop screen. The woman on the right, dressed in a professional blazer, is listening attentively while holding a notepad. On the table, there are several folders, a smartphone, and a white coffee mug. In the background, large glass windows let in ample natural light. Overall, the atmosphere appears highly productive and collaborative.

photos.imageDescription: Một nhóm bạn/đồng nghiệp đang ngồi trò chuyện thư giãn và trao đổi ngoài trời trên bãi cỏ công viên.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: This photograph was taken outdoors in an urban public park on a bright, sunny afternoon. In the foreground, several people are sitting together on a green lawn, engaging in a lively and casual conversation. One person is reading a printed document while others are gesturing and smiling cheerfully. In the background, modern city skyscrapers rise behind tall leafy trees under a clear blue sky. Overall, the scene looks remarkably peaceful and enjoyable as people unwind outdoors.

tasks.partName: Trả lời câu hỏi tình huống (Respond to Questions)
tasks.scenario: Imagine that an American marketing firm is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a telephone survey about food shopping.

questions.question: What types of food stores are there in your neighborhood?
questions.modelAnswer: In my neighborhood, there is a large modern supermarket just a five-minute walk away, along with several local grocery stores and organic fruit stands that offer fresh daily produce.

questions.question: How often do you go food shopping and when do you usually go?
questions.modelAnswer: I usually go food shopping twice a week, typically on Wednesday evenings after work and on Saturday mornings when the fresh supplies are newly restocked.

questions.question: Describe what you buy and why you make those purchases.
questions.modelAnswer: Whenever I go food shopping, I primarily buy fresh vegetables, lean chicken breast, and whole-grain bread for healthy home cooking. In addition, I purchase dairy items and seasonal fruit to prepare quick, nutritious breakfast smoothies before heading to the office.

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Some people enjoy the excitement of city life. Other people prefer the peace and quiet of small-town living. Would you rather live in a big city or a small town? Why? Use specific examples to show your preference.
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I would definitely prefer to live in a big city rather than a small town for two main reasons. First, metropolitan cities offer vastly superior career opportunities and modern public transportation. For example, living in a bustling city allows professionals to commute easily via subway and attend international industry conferences. Second, cities provide diverse cultural entertainment, including world-class dining, theater performances, and vibrant shopping districts. Therefore, the convenience and vibrancy of urban living make it my preferred choice.
